purpose: The ONE definition of the Porch & Party business entity (the shared authority piece, entity.json): the @id, name, url, logo, description, sameAs and legal parent the single LocalBusiness node on every published page declares. Read by scripts/lib/contact_surface.js (canonicalBusiness writes sameAs from here, exactly), scripts/retrofit_root_pages.js and scripts/retrofit_answer_cards.js (parentOrganization), scripts/validators/validate_entity_graph.mjs and validate_business_entity.js (the fast checks), and scripts/entity/entity_backlink_watch.mjs (the weekly watch).
origin: Authority audit, 30 Oct 2026: the Facebook Page and Google Business Profile sameAs were spread across scripts/lib/contact_surface.js and the retrofit scripts, merged with whatever sameAs a page already carried (a dead profile could never leave), and nothing checked that either profile still resolved or linked back. This file is the one list; the watch keeps it true.
truth_boundary: sameAs holds ONLY profiles that really exist and resolve now. Never this site's own host, never a Spry Labs or West Peek host (forbidden_same_as_hosts). A profile named but not yet live goes in profiles_pending with url null and enters sameAs only when the weekly watch sees it resolve - and, where the platform renders server-side, link back. Nobody guesses a URL: a guessed handle can belong to another business.
